name: kisi
description: SI/PI analysis of KiCad boards with the kisi CLI: prepare a board (missing laminate data, impedance targets, interface standards, load currents – researched with sources into <board>.kisi.json) and review it (impedance, channel loss/TDR/eye against PCIe/USB/DDR/... profiles, vias, crosstalk, regulator chains, DC IR drop, PDN impedance).
